head_commit.message:
Statement register and packet docs: record the 13 round-4 proof-packet theorems and the triage of the Props without a theorem (no hosted receipt yet)

Register (specifications/lean_statements_20261010/REGISTER.json): 13 `proved`
statement entries for the theorems of SpecificationProofs/{Side24Analysis,
Side24Interfaces, RNCluster}.lean committed at 80e80243 (12 under
side24-coefficient, 1 under OA-C6-RARE-CLUSTER-20260929-v1), each with the
Prop's own anchor and the docstring's "Does not establish" field; the 10
proof-packet kernel_evidence rows regenerated with four receipt tiers (runs
38116277597, 38121713840, 38149888699 / 38149524759, each named with its PR
head and actual tested merge commit, corroborated on PR head 12e072d6 by run
38150363063 / merge 86a6e8c8…), and the 13 round-4 theorems marked as having
NO hosted receipt yet (the first lean-specification-proofs.yml run on this
branch is their first receipt); not_established / next_step of
side24-coefficient, math.side24-coefficient and OA-C6-RARE-CLUSTER regenerated;
one round-4 triage sentence appended to next_step of the other 27 triaged rows
(per-Prop verdicts PROVABLE_WITH_WORK / BLOCKED_MISSING_MATHLIB with the named
Mathlib gap / BLOCKED_INTERFACE with its refuting inhabitant /
PREDICATE_VOCABULARY). Claim-level labels unchanged on all 171 rows (138 none,
33 specified); statements 339 -> 352, proved entries 142 -> 155,
kernel_evidence rows 27 -> 28.

Statement packet README.md / SCOPE.md: Declarations and Claims sections
re-rendered from the register (72 of 141 Props now have a theorem; the 13
round-4 theorems carry the dagger "no hosted receipt yet" in every table and
header). Proof packet README.md / SCOPE.md: inventory 73 theorems over 72
Props; the triage's corrections of the previous informal reasons recorded row
by row as corrections of reasons, not statement defects; triage verdicts are
scheduling labels with no authority over register labels.

Generated by scripts kept outside the repository (update_register8.py,
render_docs8.py), after this lane's own adversarial verification of the first
rendering (same account, credit 0) found and fixed: BLOCKED_MISSING_MATHLIB
items that named present lemmas instead of the absent Kac-Rice / Rice formula;
an over-general "superseded" sentence now scoped to the twelve Side24 Props
proved in round 4; the omitted antecedent 0 < a of Theorem O; "proved Props"
vocabulary; singular grammar; a receipt-free row that inherited other rows'
receipt text.

Checks at this tree: statement check.py --allow-dirty SOURCE_CHECK_PASS (352
statements, 150 local declarations); test_check.py 97 tests OK in normal and -O
modes; proof check.py --allow-dirty SOURCE_CHECK_PASS (73 theorems). No Lean
byte changed. Scientific effect NONE; alignment PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW;
organizational-independence credit 0; a proof-packet theorem is evidence about
its registered Prop for the formal objects only, never about the informal claim.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Cz7WZybv8znP64SpPj6sWY
